contract.purpose: Make the episodes-spent to shipping-changes ratio visible while a line of work is still running.
contract.shipping_candidate: A named concrete change to agent/agent.py that alters DEFAULT behaviour, with a paired measurement behind it. A new script, a default-off knob, a ledger entry, an instrument repair or a negative result does not count.
contract.on_warning: Not an instruction to stop. State explicitly why the line still deserves episodes; a hard negative can be worth a hundred.
contract.counter: Episodes are recorded by the runners; candidates are added by hand. A line that keeps measuring degrades its own ratio unattended.
